text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That felt amazing! Trainer, were you 
watching!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! I think I'm starting to get the feel 
of racing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm all set for the big race! I will 
definitely seize the victory!

Taiki Shuttle ran brilliantly even under 
the conditions of a dirt track.

I never once doubted her abilities, but 
her growth never fails to astonish me—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer-san! Next up is finally—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
First up, a steak and carrot juice 
celebration party! ♪
